tags: How this page works, a block of ronishbhatt.com
drafts.content: This HTML is twenty-two lines plus one small script, and until you click something no library at all; everything else on the page is a Nostr event signed by this site's key and rendered in place. The page is pre-rendered from [my relay](https://relay.ronishbhatt.com) at deploy, then your browser asks the relay again and rebuilds itself only if something changed, so edits appear live in every open tab. The chat is NIP-17 (NIP-59 gift wraps, NIP-44 encryption, NIP-13 proof of work), each block is a NIP-23 note you can open in any client through the ⌁ beside its heading, and the icon is the first sixteen hex digits of the signing key, one shade of green per digit.
